description_en: Queries task statistics in Task Center
name: DescribeHistoryTasksStat

parameters.help_en:
The task status. Valid values:

Scheduled: The task is waiting to be executed.

Running: The task is running.

Succeed: The task is successful.

Cancelling: The task is being canceled.

Canceled: The task is canceled.

Waiting: The task is waiting for a scheduled time.

To query tasks in multiple states, separate the states with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, tasks in all states are queried
parameters.help_zh:
任务状态，取值范围如下：
Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间

如需查询多个状态则用英文逗号分隔，默认为空，表示全选
parameters.name: status

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. This corresponds to the ins_name parameter. You can specify up to 30 instance IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 实例ID，对应ins_name，多个英文逗号分隔，最多支持30个
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The task ID. You can specify up to 30 task IDs. Separate multiple IDs with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, this parameter is not used as a filter
parameters.help_zh: 任务 ID。如有多个任务 ID，使用英文用逗号分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_id

parameters.help_en: The task type. This parameter is used to query tasks of a specific type. You can specify up to 30 task types. Separate multiple types with commas (,). If you leave this parameter empty, this parameter is not used as a filter
parameters.help_zh: 任务类型，用于查询特定类型任务情况，如有多个用英文逗号分隔，最多支持 30 个，默认为空，表示不限制
parameters.name: task_type

parameters.help_en: The beginning of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的起始时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: from_start_time

parameters.help_en: The end of the time range to query. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
parameters.help_zh: 任务开始时间的结束时间。按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC +0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ
parameters.name: to_start_time

parameters.help_en: The minimum running time. The query returns tasks with a running time greater than this value. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 执行时间区间开始，单位秒，左开右闭
parameters.name: from_exec_time

parameters.help_en: The maximum running time. The query returns tasks with a running time less than or equal to this value. Unit: seconds
parameters.help_zh: 执行时间区间结束，单位秒，左开右闭
parameters.name: to_exec_time

Status.description_en:
The task status.

Scheduled: The task is waiting to be executed.

Running: The task is running.

Succeed: The task is successful.

Failed: The task failed.

Cancelling: The task is being canceled.

Canceled: The task is canceled.

Waiting: The task is waiting for a scheduled time
Status.description_zh:
任务状态。

Scheduled：等待执行
Running：执行中
Succeed：执行成功
Failed：执行失败
Cancelling：正在终止
Canceled：已终止
Waiting：等待预设时间
